dialogues.speaker: Wislawa
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm almost out of holiday. Who knows when we'll meet again...

choices.text: Might as well take the opportunity to play another wargame.

response.speaker: Wislawa
response.text: Ha, you're right, why not focus on having a little fun while I'm still off duty?

choices.text: How about you try sparring with me?

response.speaker: Wislawa
response.text: Haha, take it easy. I'd prefer not to throw hands with you unless it was utterly unavoidable.

response.speaker: Wislawa
response.text: I'd much prefer to find out once and for all who's stronger, me or Edler. She's a fitting opponent — a contest is only fun when both sides are evenly matched, am I right?

choices.text: I look forward to seeing you the next time you're off duty.

response.speaker: Wislawa
response.text: Me too... If only I had a little more holiday to take.

response.speaker: Wislawa
response.text: Then maybe I could be like you, traveling around without a care in the world...
